podcast.title: Early Rock Bands
podcast.body: Spencer began his musical career as a drummer in a pre-teen rock band called The Blisters, later joining another group called The Monsters. "He's a drummer who started with a pre-teen rock band called The Blisters before moving on to another group called The Monsters."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Livestreaming with Father
podcast.body: Spencer and his father, Jeff Tweedy, have frequently livestreamed performances together. "And since then, they have learned to livestream together a lot."
